All three voters agree on OK and different_formulation; I confirmed it from pp. 106-107 and the Lean source. initial_runInvariant (σ_0 = 1/5, state 0 = initialCycleState) unfolds to residual W_{7/10}, mean and defects at 6/5, cumulative M_{9/10}/M_{19/10}, wave W_{1/2}, difference W_{17/25}, zero moments and reconstruction. The construction order matches (8.12), (8.20), (8.25). PAIRING's correction stands: the analytic part is the refinedCarrier version, ActualCoreSupport.initial_invariant. MATHEMATICS dissents only on materiality; both findings are low and recoverable. PAIRING's claim that MeanHypotheses lacks divergence data is wrong. Not checked here: virtualTheta/virtualAxial against (8.3), the chart residual's Q-normalization, and the edge weight against (6.23).

findings.summary: The invariant's mean field bounds the good mean residual (E minus the angular means of the stored Gaussian and alias errors), not E_θ, E_z directly. raw_mean_bounds recovers E_θ, E_z ∈ M_{6/5} from the same invariant.

Definition 9.4's structural clauses (mean correction divergence-free and curl-plus-azimuthal, Prop 9.3 decomposition with flat remainder) are not dedicated fields of the stage invariant. Separate stage-0 theorems and the construction supply them.
